sources.candidate: Apply admission-buffer-ownership.patch to Boundary; World production unchanged.

reuse.intervention: Reuse an immutable-set operation result only when the independent fact dimensions have identical input roots. Preserve initialized, available, obligations and liveness separately.
reuse.reason: Prepared.init remains 1869/4041 inclusive samples; Flow.write repeatedly inserts the same slot into coincident roots.
reuse.target: At least 5% lower install64 full-path median in two rotating windows; no higher peak allocation and no repeatable value/tiny regression outside paired ranges.
reuse.preservation: Same roots for all fact dimensions at all positions, same admission errors and fixed-point checking order; uninitialized and consumed remain distinct.

buffers.intervention: Facts owns its set pool buffers directly through the parent allocator, so table/array growth frees predecessor allocations. The arena continues to own immutable result arrays. Pool accounts actual held buffers; Facts and Admitted storage totals include them.
buffers.target: at least 25% lower install64 peak working allocation, and reduced captured Agent start/reply peaks, without repeatable latency regression outside matched noise
buffers.preserved: same set roots/facts/Program identity; one Facts.deinit and complete construction error cleanup; immutable base lifetime; exact held-capacity accounting
buffers.alternative: Copying into compact final storage after arena-backed analysis would retain the original construction peak and could increase it; it does not address the measured peak objective.
